title: docs(pm-dispatch): platform-readings line 403 follows the ADR-0131 D9/D13 schema rule, not the retired tenancy ledger
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DMMchS2pMx7VafJmdzGaxFv)_

Fixes #25244
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Summary

One line of `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` (line 403) still said the D9 system-write stamp only recognised the `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY` ledger's `tenant-scoped` class. That ledger retired with ADR-0131 D13, and the stamp's scope is decided by the object's schema alone, as `Engine.buildDriverOptions` in `packages/objectql` reads it through `resolveTenantFieldName`: a tenant column and not federated ⇒ in scope; no tenant column (`tenancy.enabled: false`, `systemFields.tenant: false`, no tenant field) or federated ⇒ auto-muted. The line now states that rule and cites ADR-0131 D9 / D13 by name; `reach: in` still only says a tenant column exists.

- Edited in place: 1 line, 119 bytes (cap 120), file stays 460 lines at its 460 ceiling, no ceiling moved.
- `git grep -n PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY -- .claude` is empty afterwards.
- Verified against `origin/main` e58bd0e: `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` `buildDriverOptions` (`isTenantAuditInScope = resolveTenantFieldName(objectSchema) !== null && !isFederated`), and `docs/adr/0131-*.md` carries `### D9` and `### D13`.

## Gates (local, head 67003ee)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 20 commands; all 20 ran with exit 0 (`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` among them; `check:doc-formula-expressions` first answered exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET, re-run after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` → exit 0). `--ran` reconciliation: 20 derived, 20 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Ratchet verdict line: `platform-readings.md is 460 lines (ceiling 460; headroom 0)`.

Diff touches `.claude/**` only (Tier S governed surface); no published package moves, so `skip-changeset` is declared with this create.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么:** `platform-readings.md` 第 403 行一行改写:D9 盖章按 schema 裁(有租户列且非联邦才在范围),引 ADR-0131 D9/D13,不再点名已删除的 `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY` 账本。行数与字节上限都未动。

**为什么改:** 该账本随 #25201 退役后,这行读起来会把席位引去找一个已不存在的符号;引擎里 `buildDriverOptions` 早已只按 schema 判定。
